description: fly sftp put refuses to overwrite files that already exist on the volume. rput() must use 'fly ssh console -C cat > $2 < $1' to pipe stdin into the remote file, which overwrites cleanly. Current behavior: re-running the script after first run leaves stale data on Fly. Fix: rput() { fly ssh console -a "$APP" -C "cat > $2" < "$1"; }
title: sync-to-fly.sh rput fails silently — fly sftp put refuses to overwrite existing files
